sources.housing: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), used to index the existing housing-tier benchmarks over time
sources.groceries: USDA Moderate-Cost Food Plan baseline for a one-person adult household, updated with BLS food-at-home CPI
sources.utilities: Existing metro utility benchmark, updated with BLS fuels-and-utilities CPI
sources.transport: Existing metro transportation benchmark, updated with BLS transportation CPI
sources.discretionary: Existing metro discretionary benchmark, updated with BLS recreation CPI
